description: React component for the Deployments page in a data management dashboard, displaying deployment data with server-side sorting, custom rendering, and chart integration.

methods.name: fmtDate
methods.description: Formats a date value into a locale string or returns a placeholder if invalid.

methods.name: renderProject
methods.description: Renders the project name or ID with a tooltip showing deployment ID.

methods.name: renderDeploymentId
methods.description: Renders the full deployment ID with styling to prevent overflow.

methods.name: renderStatus
methods.description: Renders the deployment status badge or placeholder.

methods.name: buildColumns
methods.description: Constructs the columns configuration for the DataTable.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Fetches deployment data from backend with server-side sorting and updates state.
